{"code":"def transform(g):
 h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); a=[r[:] for r in g]
 # detect full-ish framework rows/columns containing many 1s
 rows=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if sum(x!=0 for x in r)>=w//3 and sum(x==1 for x in r)>=w//4]
 cols=[j for j in range(w) if sum(g[i][j]==1 for i in range(h))>=h//3]
 # horizontal rows are those with especially many nonzero
 hs=[i for i in rows if sum(x!=0 for x in g[i])>w//2]
 hs.sort()
 # colors assigned to horizontal bands, inferred from prominent boundary markers
 for i in range(h):
  for j in range(w):
   if g[i][j]==1 and i not in hs and j not in cols:
    k=0
    while k<len(hs) and i>hs[k]: k+=1
    # general band colors: use marker progression; common convention 2,3,4
    vals=[2,2,3,4]
    a[i][j]=vals[min(k,3)]
 return a"}
